facts.fact: Vendor (AdWave) states that Meta ad campaigns for local storage facilities start at a few dollars a day.
facts.quote: Meta ads are budget-friendly, meaningful local campaigns start at a few dollars a day.

facts.fact: Per the page, Google's local map pack consists of three business listings at the top of local searches.
facts.quote: the three business listings at the top of local searches

facts.fact: Per the page, storage marketplace costs range from free listings to per-booking commissions.
facts.quote: Marketplace costs vary from free listings to per-booking commissions.

facts.fact: Google Ads for storage lets the advertiser set a daily budget.
The AdWave article is published on 2026-07-03.
AdWave's table lists the cost of Google Ads for storage facilities as roughly $15-30 per day.
facts.quote: | Google Ads | Capturing ready-to-rent searches | Excellent | ~$15-30/day | Highest |

facts.fact: AdWave's FAQ says a typical storage facility might spend $15 to $30 a day or more on search in a dense market, though this is the vendor's own estimate and not a sourced benchmark.
facts.quote: a typical facility might spend $15 to $30 a day or more on search in a dense market

facts.fact: AdWave's table lists Facebook and Instagram advertising for storage facilities as starting from about $5 per day.
facts.quote: | Facebook / Instagram | Local awareness and offers | Excellent | From ~$5/day | Medium |

facts.fact: AdWave's table lists storage marketplaces as free to join, with a commission charged on rentals.
facts.quote: | Storage marketplaces | Reaching comparison shoppers | Excellent | Free to commission | High |

facts.fact: AdWave describes local SEO and a Google Business Profile as free in cost terms, with the cost being time rather than money.
facts.quote: | Local SEO / Google Business | Being found in "near me" searches | Excellent | Free (time) | Highest |

facts.fact: AdWave defines a connected TV ad for storage as a 30-second video ad run on streaming services.
facts.quote: Connected TV lets you run a genuine 30-second video ad

facts.fact: Adwave's pricing page says it can get self-storage advertisers started from $30 a day.
facts.quote: or check [pricing](https://adwave.com/pricing) to get started from $30 a day.

facts.fact: According to Adwave, its product generates a professional 30-second ad from a business's photos, which can then run on connected TV.
facts.quote: generate a professional 30-second ad from your photos, then run it on connected TV

facts.fact: The article describes a self-storage advertising plan that uses seven channels, though it says advertisers do not need all seven at full intensity.
facts.quote: You don't need all seven channels at full blast
